messages.subject: Letters for Kestrel / Northfield / Vireo
messages.body:
Dear Daniel and Sven,

Thank you again for agreeing to write for my postdoc fellowship applications. All three are due Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 5:00 pm ET. Each program gives me a letter link that any writer can use:

Kestrel Postdoctoral Fellowship: https://kestrel-fellowship.example.org/letters/KF27-0412
Northfield Foundation Fellowship: https://northfield-foundation.example.org/recommend/NF27-1187
Vireo Fellowship: https://vireo-fellowship.example.org/letters/VF27-5531

I'll send my final research statement once it's done.

Best,
Ana

messages.subject: Re: Letters for Kestrel / Northfield / Vireo
messages.body:
Of course, Ana. Calendar note made for all three.

Daniel

messages.subject: Re: Letters for Kestrel / Northfield / Vireo
messages.body:
Happy to, Ana - I have the three links. I'll aim for late November.

Sven

messages.subject: Re: Letters for Kestrel / Northfield / Vireo
messages.body:
Hi Ana,

Quick update on letters. I'm happy to support Kestrel and Northfield and will have both in well before Dec 1. Vireo I can't do, though: I've just been seated on the Vireo selection panel for the Larch Hall cycle, so I can't write for any applicant there and you'll need someone else for that one. The panel list isn't public until awards are announced in March, so please keep my seat between us.

Best,
Sven
